text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"\"Master's degree ... from MIT\" vs \"from Ohio State University\"","dimension":"pedigree","description":"This captures the perceived prestige or selectivity of the applicant's academic background.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"9 other languages in the mix\" vs \"5 other languages in the mix\"","dimension":"breadth of language experience","description":"This captures how many different programming languages the applicant signals exposure to beyond Go.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"building with AI, shipping language-model features\" appears earlier and more prominently vs later in the letter","dimension":"AI emphasis","description":"This captures how strongly the letter foregrounds experience with AI and language-model work as relevant to the role.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"done proper security assessments\" and \"threat models and follow-through\"","dimension":"security assessment experience","description":"This captures explicit hands-on experience evaluating systems for security rather than only general interest in security.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"designed agent systems end to end\" and \"Python agents useful autonomy\"","dimension":"agentic systems experience","description":"This captures concrete experience building agent-based tooling and Python-driven automation for the role's agentic focus.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"\"CompTIA Security+ certification\"","dimension":"formal security credential","description":"This captures the presence of an explicit security certification or credential supporting the applicant's security profile.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"\"Help busy developer teams do the secure thing by default\" vs \"I play capture-the-flag competitions\"","dimension":"security community engagement","description":"This captures whether the letter shows security involvement through practical team-facing impact or through enthusiast participation in security competitions.","winner":"B"}]}
